messages.author: dae01c57a3c54a3a
messages.subject: multi_gp usage?
parts:
I just stumbled across the multi_gp & multi_gp_cholesky functions in the manual and wonder if anyone has any examples using these (the GP section of the manual instead uses multi_normal and multi_normal_cholesky). 

I'm particularly trying to figure out how the "w" parameter to multi_gp/multi_gp_cholesky maps to the eta/rho/sigma parameters in the examples using multi_normal. My guess is that if you construct Sigma without multiplying by eta but instead dividing sigma by eta on the diagonal, then w would then map as 1/eta, but possibly I'm incorrect?

Mike

--
Mike Lawrence
Graduate Student
Department of Psychology & Neuroscience
Dalhousie University

~ Certainty is (possibly) folly ~
